text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, just a little more...
On a full-moon night... simmered until morning...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: A su... per... magi... cal... potion... is all... fi... nished...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fortunately, the fire had gone out on its own, but Sweep Tosho was left crestfallen after burning her special magic potion.
